IkosTech · Odoo Integration Help

Official API: https://api.ikostech.es/it

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST · Base URL: https://api.ikostech.es/it

Auth: X-API-Key header

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "api_key": "your_api_key_here"
}
  • API key is required for all endpoints.
  • Rate limit: 1 request per second (strictly enforced).

2) Default Procedure

  1. Build devices plan → extract serial + sensor field mapping from device/sensor config.
  2. Fetch readings → call /export/node/{serial}/data/json/{from}/{to} per unique serial/field combo.
  3. Upsert readings → store in mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading with UTC timestamps.

3) Device Configuration

In each Device (mdm.measurement.device) set remotecontrol_params:

{
  "serial": "10329694",
  "start_date": "2026-01-01"
}

4) Sensor Configuration

In each Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) set remotecontrol_params:

{
  "field": "hsuelo"
}

where field is one of the available IkosTech measurement fields:

  • hamb - Ambient humidity (%)
  • tamb - Ambient temperature (°C)
  • hsuelo - Soil humidity (%)
  • tsuelo - Soil temperature (°C)
  • conductividad - Soil conductivity (mS/cm)
  • radiacion - Solar radiation (W/m²)
  • radiacion_umol - PAR radiation (μmol/m²/s)
  • radiacion_global - Global solar radiation (W/m²)
  • dpv - Vapor pressure deficit (kPa)
  • bateria - Battery level (%)
  • calidad - Signal quality (0-4)

5) Time Window & Date Chunking

  • Build devices plan computes initial_date per sensor: last stored reading date → else device.start_date → else Jan 1 of current year.
  • Fetch readings splits long date ranges into 30-day chunks to prevent API 502/504 gateway timeouts.
  • Date format: YYYYMMDD (e.g., 20260601)
  • Timestamps in response are treated as local time (UTC) and stored as such.

6) Endpoint Details

GET /export/nodes

List all available devices/serials accessible to your API key.

Response: Array of device objects with serial, alias, device, estado, etc.

GET /export/node/{serial}/data/json/{from}/{to}

Fetch raw readings for a specific device within a date range.

Parameters:

  • {serial} - Device serial number
  • {from} - Start date in YYYYMMDD format
  • {to} - End date in YYYYMMDD format

Response: Array of reading objects with fields like fecha, serial, hamb, tsuelo, etc.

7) Rate Limiting

IkosTech strictly enforces 1 request per second per API key.

The system automatically adds a 1.1 second delay between requests.

Large date ranges are split into 30-day chunks to balance speed vs. API limits.

8) Operational Flow

  1. Load devices + sensors with remotecontrol_params configured
  2. For each sensor, determine date range: last_reading → today
  3. Split date range into 30-day chunks
  4. For each chunk, call API with 1.1 sec delay between requests
  5. Parse response, extract the specific field value from each reading
  6. Upsert readings into Odoo with UTC timestamp
  7. Post audit JSON with per-sensor/per-chunk diagnostics

9) Error Handling

  • Missing field in response: Logged as warning, reading skipped
  • Invalid timestamp: Logged, reading skipped
  • API timeout/error: Batch persists upserts before reporting, so no data is lost
  • Rate limit: Automatic 1.1 sec delay prevents 429 errors

10) Timezone Handling

IkosTech timestamps are provided as-is (assumed UTC).

Odoo stores readings in UTC without conversion.
